description: React component for displaying and managing a list of questions with user progress, including confetti animation on completion, and controls for marking questions as known, unknown, or skipped.

classes.name: UserQuestionProgress
classes.description: Type defining user's progress with questions, including arrays for 'know', 'dontKnow', and 'skip'.

classes.name: QuestionProgressType
classes.description: Type representing keys of UserQuestionProgress, i.e., 'know', 'dontKnow', or 'skip'.

classes.name: QuestionsListProps
classes.description: Type for props accepted by QuestionsList component, including questions array and optional className.

methods.name: QuestionsList
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering questions, progress, and controls for user interaction.

methods.name: resetProgress
methods.description: Resets user progress and question index to initial state.

methods.name: updateQuestionStatus
methods.description: Updates user's progress for a question based on status ('know', 'dontKnow', 'skip') and advances to next question.
